map.为数字生成虚拟格子位置编码，结合图像记忆法，帮助快速记忆长串数字或词表，提升记力: Generate virtual grid position codes for numbers, combined with image memory methods, to help memorize long digit strings or word lists quickly and improve recall.
map.把要记的内容挂到熟悉空间的固定位置，练联想记忆。: Hang what you want to remember at fixed positions in a familiar space to practice associative memory.
map.背单词、记清单、备赛时用。: For memorizing vocabulary, lists and competition prep.
map.：选家里 5 个位置(门/沙发/桌/窗/床)，每桩挂 2 件：门口放「牛奶+鸡蛋: : pick 5 spots at home (door/sofa/table/window/bed) and hang 2 items per locus: "milk + eggs" at the door, "apple + bread" on the sofa, and so on; walk through in order to recall, so 10 items rarely get missed.
map.：把 apple/book/cat/dog/sun 分别「放」在 5 个房间桩，: : "place" apple/book/cat/dog/sun at 5 room loci, walk through the space with your eyes closed to recite them, which sticks better than rote repetition.
map.用最熟的路径(回家动线)且顺序固定；桩要鲜明有反差，挂的意象越夸张越好记。桩数随: Use the most familiar route (the way home) with a fixed order; loci should be vivid and contrasting, and the more exaggerated the image hung there, the easier it is to recall. The number of loci grows with the content, with 10-20 being common.
